findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "trigger_page_scan" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Trigger a new scan of a single page on a domain available to this key. The domain must already be tracked in benchmarq (onboard it at app-benchmarq first) -- ne…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "trigger_page_scan" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page_scores, get_page_issues, get_site_issues, get_competitor_report, get_competitor_gap · Private data: get_page_scores, trigger_page_scan, get_page_report, get_site_issues, get_site_history · Public sink: get_competitor_gap · Destructive: get_page_scores, get_page_issues, trigger_page_scan, get_page_report, get_site_issues.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page_scores, get_page_issues, get_site_issues, get_competitor_report, get_competitor_gap · Private data: get_page_scores, trigger_page_scan, get_page_report, get_site_issues, get_site_history · Public sink: get_competitor_gap · Destructive: get_page_scores, get_page_issues, trigger_page_scan, get_page_report, get_site_issues

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
